comment: Per-shot allowances against the approved reference. A shot not listed must match exactly in the local acceptance run (exact mode) and within the default 0.5% bad blocks in CI (structural mode). Add an entry only with a reason; never recapture the reference.

page-terms--desktop.png.reason: kramdown typographic apostrophes (don’t) as published by the Jekyll site; the mockup used straight quotes. Owner-reversible: typographic() in src/content/content.ts

page-terms--mobile.png.reason: same: typographic apostrophes | CI (structural mode): text-dense shot re-wrapped by the GitHub runner's fonts; measured 0.873% bad blocks on the first CI run, limit set per shot at ~2-2.5x. tests/visual-structural.test.mjs proves blank/erased/inverted/shifted versions of this shot are still rejected under it (blank pages score 10-35%).

contentDependent.reason: These shots render lists built from all articles, tags, series and curated items (home, tag and series pages, and the search / appearance panels opened over the home page). They cannot match a frozen reference once content has been added. Article pages, themes, Contact, Terms and 404 do not depend on other content and stay mandatory.
